# Built by Blanch

Built by Blanch is an independent web design and development studio operated by Nick Blanchard. It creates clear, custom, mobile-friendly websites for local businesses, professional practices, community organizations, shops, and restaurants.

Service areas include Saratoga Springs, Glens Falls, Lake George, and nearby communities in New York. Built by Blanch works remotely with businesses outside those areas when the project is a good fit.

Core services:
- Website strategy, information architecture, and conversion-focused page planning
- Custom responsive web design and frontend development
- Website rebuilds and focused improvements to existing sites
- Technical launch preparation, metadata, structured data, sitemaps, and indexing setup
- Optional website care and content updates after launch
